# VMC (3D avatars) sub-actions

![Adding a sub-action: on the Actions page, click + Sub-action and search for it](../../assets/screens/actions-sub-action-picker.png)

## Clear avatar expressions (VMC)

Takes expressions off your 3D avatar again (sets them back to 0).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Expressions** | The expression names to take off, separated by commas. Starts as: `Joy, Angry, Sorrow, Fun, Surprised`. |

<small>Type id: `vmc.clearExpressions`</small>

## Show avatar expression (VMC)

Makes your 3D avatar show an expression, like a smile, using VMC. Works with VSeeFace, VMagicMirror, VNyan, Warudo and other apps with a VMC receiver.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Expression** | The expression's name on your avatar. Every VRM avatar has Joy, Angry, Sorrow, Fun and Surprised; yours may have more. |
| **Strength** | How strong, from 0 (none) to 1 (full), or a percentage like 50%. Empty means full. |
| **For (seconds)** | How long to show it before it goes away. Empty means it stays until another step changes it. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%vmc.strength%` | The strength sent, from 0 to 1 |

<small>Type id: `vmc.expression`</small>
